reviews.text: My dog looks like a million dollars! Will absolutely be coming back! Well worth the money!
Got a Christmas gift from.my boss to groomed Suzie. She look so good
Our doodle always comes back looking great

We’ve tried several groomers on the West Side for our three dogs and these ladies are the best. They are genuinely concerned about the animals’ well being - they always let us know if there’s anything they find a little concerning (most recently, a possible eye problem that I’d missed) and our dogs always come home happy …and beautiful!
